verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a 401(k) or any retirement plan offering. Rippling documents that general benefits deductions flow into payroll (rippling-docs-13) and that HSA, FSA and commuter deductions sync with payroll (rippling-docs-24). These are adjacent benefit types and do not show that a retirement plan can be offered with contributions synced to each payroll.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll
